name: Yandere Kanojo no H na Semarikata
original_name: ヤンデレ彼女のHなせまり方
source:
"Aahhhh dammit, I want to get laid!"

Sorry about that. My internal narrative slipped out.
Usually I'm very meek and docile.

But it sucks to be surrounded by people who've had sex.
They exude an aura of "hey, I'm different from you."
Well good for you, f*ckhead! Dammit!

Anyway that was my life, until one fateful day.
I rescued a drowning love god from the river. As a reward, the god promised me a way to have sex big time!

The next day at school all the girls were obsessed with me. I was honestly pleased, but these girls were wacky in love! Psychopathic, even! Out of their heads.

「啊啊啊，该死，我想上床！」

抱歉，内心独白不小心说出口了。
平时我其实很温顺。

但被一群做过爱的人包围实在糟透了。
他们散发出「嘿，我和你不一样」的气场。
那可真替你高兴，混蛋！该死！

总之，那就是我的生活，直到命运般的一天。
我从河里救起一名溺水的爱神。作为报答，神答应给我一种大干一场的方法！

第二天到学校，所有女孩都迷恋上我。老实说我很高兴，但这些女孩的恋爱方式太疯狂了！甚至带有精神病态，完全失去理智。
